# Home Management

> Home Management is a free, privacy-first web app for tracking household water, heating and electricity consumption. It runs in the browser without an account, with optional Google sign-in to sync data across devices.

Home Management helps households log utility meter readings, understand their consumption and spot waste early. Data is stored locally in the browser by default (local-first); cloud sync via Firebase is opt-in. There are no ads and no third-party tracking. Meter photo recognition (OCR) runs entirely on the device.

- Website: https://home-management.dev/
- App: https://home-management.dev/dashboard
- Country Benchmarks: https://home-management.dev/dashboard/benchmarks
- Full technical & methodology reference: https://home-management.dev/llms-full.txt
- Price: free for personal and other noncommercial use
- License: source-available under the Prosperity Public License 3.0.0 (noncommercial use is free; commercial use requires a license after a 30-day trial)
- Languages: English (`/`), German (`/de`), Bosnian (`/bs`), Serbian (`/sr`), Indonesian (`/id`), Polish (`/pl`)
- Platform: any modern web browser; installable as a progressive web app (PWA)

## Features

- Water tracking: warm and cold water meters for kitchen and bathroom, cold-water-only mode, meter replacement handling, spike and leak alerts
- Heating tracking: per-room consumption with configurable rooms and radiators, seasonal patterns, room-level spike detection
- Electricity tracking: kWh meter readings with daily, weekly and monthly trends and meter swap handling
- Comparisons: household and per-person consumption, benchmarked against national averages for 60+ countries
- Forecasting: statistical predictions (linear and polynomial regression, moving averages) with seasonal adjustment
- Meter reading by photo: client-side OCR with Tesseract.js; images never leave the device
- Import and export: Excel (.xlsx) import with column mapping, Excel/JSON export, PDF reports, and smart text import from pasted notes or emails
- Demo mode: explore all features with realistic sample data without entering anything
- Themes and accessibility: light and dark themes, keyboard navigation, responsive layout
